findings.claim_text: L2Beat's independent tracking characterizes the council as a 7-of-8 multisig that can act as a **direct executor**, meaning upgrades can bypass the timelock delay entirely rather than being gated by it — a materially more centralized picture than "seven days to react."

Ripe's own archives confirm that two components covered by its published audits — the "Juice Score" incentive system and GREEN bonds — were subsequently stripped from the launched protocol, "removed to reduce complexity" and "removed to reduce risk" respectively.
